{{Top|leg}}
'''Tirginni cologne''' was a type of expensive [[Perfume/Legends|perfume]] made from extracted scent glands of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector's]] [[tirginni beast]]. Subtly scented, the cologne was only fragrant to a select number of [[Species/Legends|species]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] such as [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]], [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] and [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphids]].
